claims.text: The latest stable Pulumi CLI release is v3.261.0 (2026-09-02) per the comparison table at line 134, and v3.263.0 (2026-09-16) per the license/cadence table and Pulumi section; these two figures disagree.
Terraform's latest stable release is v1.16.1 (2026-09-02) in the comparison table, and v1.16.3 (2026-09-16) in the cadence table and Terraform section.
AWS CDK's latest stable release is v2.268.0 (2026-09-02) in the comparison table, and v2.270.0 (2026-09-17) in the cadence table and CDK section.
Azure Bicep's latest stable release is v0.46.1 (2026-07-30) in the comparison table (unchanged), and v0.47.16 (2026-09-08) in the cadence table and Bicep section.
Kubernetes' latest stable release is v1.37.0, released 2026-08-26.
Crossplane's latest stable release is v2.4.1 (2026-09-15) in the cadence table and Crossplane section, but v2.4.0 (2026-08-20) in the comparison table.
OpenTofu's latest stable release is v1.12.6, released 2026-08-19.
GitHub star counts: Pulumi ~25.7k, Terraform ~49.7k, AWS CDK ~12.9k, Bicep ~3.6k, Kubernetes ~127.9k, Crossplane ~12.1k, OpenTofu ~30.2k.
Among dedicated IaC tools, Terraform is the most-starred, followed by OpenTofu, Pulumi, AWS CDK, and Crossplane; Kubernetes leads the broader ecosystem by stars.
Spacelift's paid plans scale by private worker count rather than seats or resources, with quote-based pricing at the top end.
env zero (formerly env0) prices its paid tiers per successful apply or environment.
Google Cloud Deployment Manager reached end of support on March 31, 2026, with the service fully turned down on June 30, 2027.
Google Cloud Infrastructure Manager replaces Google Cloud Deployment Manager.
Pulumi Cloud's Free edition is free forever for one user with unlimited stacks and projects and 500 workflow minutes per month.
Pulumi Cloud Essentials starts at $40/month with 40 credits included and up to 500 managed resources.
Pulumi Cloud Pro starts at $400/month with 400 credits included and up to 2,000 managed resources.
Pulumi Cloud Enterprise pricing is custom and contract-priced.
HCP Terraform is free for up to 500 managed resources with one concurrent run, then costs roughly $0.10 to $0.99 per resource per month depending on tier.
Version, release-date, and pricing figures were checked on 2026-09-21.
